driver.name: Playwright Chromium via neutral operator relay

limits.capability: arbitrary direct navigation to a cold deep URL
limits.reason: Supported action API has no navigate/goto action and every context is forced to public /labs entry. Deep-document reload and browser history can still be exercised; neither proves a fresh-context deep-link initialization.

limits.capability: viewport-only screenshot, live geometry, contrast measurement or automated accessibility audit
limits.reason: Relay supports snapshots/semantic assertions and keyboard only. Scope requires live focus/semantics; no contrast certification is claimed. Full-page screenshots can place fixed/sticky chrome at captured scroll positions.

assertion_limit: Visibility assertions and DOM active_element establish visibility/focus by driver semantics; they do not prove the focused control is unobscured by another element. Inspect PNGs separately.
